prompt_md: Ana brings 5 logs, Ben 3 and Cleo none, and the three share the fire equally. Cleo pays 8 dollars for her share. To be fair, how many of those dollars go to Ana?
prompt_short: Ana 5 logs, Ben 3, Cleo 0 pays 8 dollars. Ana's fair share of the 8?
hint_md: How much of her own wood did each person burn?
explain_intuition_md: Everyone burns the same share, two and two-thirds logs. So Ana gave Cleo seven thirds of a log and Ben gave only one third. The 8 dollars split 7 to 1.
explain_math_md: Each uses $\frac83$ logs. Ana gave $5 - \frac83 = \frac73$, Ben gave $3 - \frac83 = \frac13$, so Ana gets $\frac{7}{8} \times 8 = 7$.
